data.source_title: Experience with uncrossmatched blood refrigerator in emergency department
data.source_setting: 945-bed ACS-verified Level I trauma center and tertiary center; adult ED patients receiving uncrossmatched RBCs from ED refrigerator
data.quantity: Observed emergency refrigerator blood use and activation counts
data.unit: patients, percent, units; median units per patient
data.source_evidence_basis: Original full-text XML: 158 adult ED patients received uncrossmatched RBC from the refrigerator; 140 were trauma patients, 37 received massive transfusion, and 89 had MTP activated. The study did not report request-to-issue time.
data.limitations: Single Level I trauma center; excludes patients who died in first 24 hours from its appropriateness subgroup analysis, and the study did not measure request-to-issue minutes. The authors used a study-specific proxy definition for potentially inappropriate transfusion.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Blood-bank model may include controlled ED emergency-stock location, issue/traceability, replenishment and compatibility follow-up, alongside central blood-bank MTP workflow. These counts describe one center and cannot establish RWJ stock levels or demand rates.
data.retrieval_timestamp_precision: day; time not logged during source inspection, midnight is a date placeholder

provenance.acquisition_method: limited factual paraphrase; inspect record-level source_access and inspected_source_url for retrieval scope; source location retained
